ambiguity.discussion:
Question: is the 36-cell FCER1A+ CD1C+ CLEC10A+ group (res_0p3 cluster 4) a distinct dendritic population, a pDC/cDC mixture, a multi-lineage doublet group, or a tail of the CD14 monocyte cluster?

Computed, supporting a DC-like program: FCER1A is detected in 83% of cells versus 1% elsewhere. CLEC10A is 69%, CD1C 50% and SERPINF1 44%. HLA-DQA1 is 97%, and HLA-DRA is higher than in monocytes (adjusted p<1e-17). LYZ is 97% but not different from monocytes. S100A8/S100A9 and FCN1 are lower than in monocytes.

Computed, mixture or doublet flags: median counts are 5297, against 1757–3756 in the other clusters at res_1. Median genes are 1570 and median mitochondrial fraction is 1.96%. CLEC4C is detected in 17% of cells, LILRA4 in 14% and IL3RA in 11%. CD3D is 17% (monocytes 9%, not different, adjusted p=0.53). NKG7 is 33% (monocytes 22%, adjusted p=0.78). CD79A is 17% (monocytes 4%, adjusted p=0.010). MS4A1 is 8% and CD79B 19%, against 86% and 92% in B cells.

Inference: a B-cell doublet-dominated group is unlikely, because MS4A1 and CD79B are low. T/NK contamination is not distinguishable from monocyte background. The high counts could reflect larger cells or some doublets. I did not compute per-cell co-detection of CD3D, CD79A and NKG7 with high counts, so doublets are unresolved. pDC admixture is plausible, but I cannot tell whether the pDC-marker cells are the same cells as the cDC2-marker cells.

Parameter sensitivity: the group separates at res_0p3, res_1, res_1p5 and in the 0.6 downsample (29 cells, all from the baseline CD14 cluster). It is absent from the baseline 0.6 clustering, where the same 36 cells sit inside the CD14 cluster. So the split is resolution-dependent and non-monotonic. Separation alone does not show a continuum or a distinct lineage.

Retrieved support: 38582791 (title/abstract only) reports FCER1A+CD1C+ dendritic cells in tumor-progression scRNA-seq, which is indirect for PBMC. 35101945 describes CD1c/CLEC10A cDC2 subsets in iPSC-derived cells and does not mention FCER1A.

Unknown: per-cell doublet status, pDC versus cDC2 composition, and donor-level replication. Keep the label tentative.
